page.layout: One printed plate, full page: a faint title line across the top, below it a grid of eight to nine circular discs in four rows, with short connecting lines between some discs. Text is printed inside each disc, too small and faded to read. No running text, no page number, no notes in the margins.
page.notes: The scan is a faded engraving of a diagram plate. The text inside the discs and the title line at the top are too small and too faint to read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible; the letter counts are estimates. The levels given are approximate, read from the placement of the discs and connecting lines (left discs unconnected, middle discs joined to right discs in rows 1 to 4, except row 2 and row 4 where the joins are less clear). No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. Some discs in the lower left are very faint and may hold further text not captured here.
